pp2.6:1.1: Tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati tattha ca sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇāti phalesu ca vasībhāvaṃ? Sammāsambuddho tena daṭṭhabbo.
pp2.6:2.1: Tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati na ca tattha sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇāti na ca phalesu vasībhāvaṃ? Paccekasambuddho tena daṭṭhabbo.
pp2.6:3.1: Tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti sāvakapāramiñ ca pāpuṇāti? Sāriputtamoggallānā tena daṭṭhabbā.
pp2.6:4.1: Tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati deṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti na ca sāvakapāramiṃ pāpuṇāti? Avasesā arahanto tena daṭṭhabbā.
pp2.6:5.1: Tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti anāgāmī hoti anāgantvā itthattaṃ? Anāgāmī tena daṭṭhabbo.
pp2.6:6.1: Tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati na ca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti sakadāgāmī hoti āgantvā itthattaṃ? Sotāpannasakadāgāmino tena daṭṭhabbā
